source.author: lucan
source.text: Sigeasque petit famae mirator arenas, Et Simoentis aquas, et Graio nobile busto Rhoetion, et multum debentes vatibus umbras.
source.text_original: Sigeasque petit famae mirator arenas, / Et Simoentis aquas, et Graio nobile busto / Rhoetion, et multum debentes vatibus umbras.
source.text_english: And, admirer of fame, he seeks the Sigean sands, and the waters of the Simois, and Rhoeteum, noble for a Greek grave, and the shades greatly indebted to the poets.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nititur hinc Talaus fratrisque Leodocus urget remo terga sui, quos nobile contulit Argos.
reuse.text_original: nititur hinc Talaus fratrisque Leodocus urget / remo terga sui, quos nobile contulit Argos.
reuse.text_english: From this side Talaus presses on, and Leodocus drives with his oar the backs of his brother’s men, whom noble Argos had brought together.
